title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Invoice Deadline, Minimum Invoice and Payment Term
content:
Three billing figures are fixed per Demurrage and Detention Free Time product:

1. **Invoicing deadline** — how many calendar days the line has, once charges stop accruing, to send out the final invoice.
2. **Minimum invoice** — the smallest per-record total, in US dollars, that is invoiced; a smaller total is not.
3. **Payment term** — the calendar days, counted from the invoice date, until a demurrage and detention invoice falls due.

| Product | Invoicing deadline (calendar days) | Minimum invoice | Payment term (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 30 | USD 25.00 | 15 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 30 | USD 25.00 | 15 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 30 | USD 25.00 | 15 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 30 | USD 25.00 | 30 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 30 | USD 25.00 | 30 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 30 | USD 50.00 | 45 |

## Points of judgement

- The invoicing deadline is uniform across the range; the minimum invoice differs only for the contract product.
- The payment term lengthens from the separate-clock products to the combined products and again for the contract product.
- A hypothetical invoice under AHL Combined Free Time 14 dated 1 June has a payment term of 30 calendar days from that date.
